# itsadecline

> itsadecline is a UK lead generation service, not a lender. It introduces homeowners who have been declined for a mortgage or homeowner loan to FCA-authorised specialist lenders. A trading name of Kaizen Finance Ltd.

## Guides
- [Why was my mortgage declined?](https://itsadecline.com/why-was-my-mortgage-declined.html)
- [Mortgage declined: what next](https://itsadecline.com/mortgage-declined-what-next.html)
- [How it works](https://itsadecline.com/how-it-works.html)
- [About itsadecline](https://itsadecline.com/about.html)

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on a mortgage or secured loan.
